VQT.Help.note: Hover a quest for its note.

VQT.Settings.Gate.Hint: Players only get the Quest Log button when their character carries the item named below. GMs always see it.

VQT.Settings.AutoOpen.Hint: Open the Quest Log automatically when you join. Per user, never for GMs.
